I have been farming this land for many years and I know what works for my cassava and cocoyam. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or spray, so I will rely on the poultry manure I keep behind the house and cuttings from my last harvest. The rains here in the South South are good and steady, so I do not need to worry about watering the crops. My daughter and grandchildren live with me and they will help with the planting and weeding on this small plot, so I will not hire any workers.
